title: Northbound habit telescope — weekly tracking & micro-experiments
content:
One-line summary: try 3 small behavior changes this month to increase weekly deep-focus time and reduce context-switch overhead; treat this doc as scratchpad and quick metrics ledger.

Why this matters (to me):
- Product work keeps getting interrupted; I feel like 80% of impact comes from a handful of uninterrupted deep blocks.
- Want a reliable way to measure small wins (not just ticket throughput).

Northbound objective (personal):
- Increase 'meaningful focus' hours from ~9/wk to 15/wk by end of Q2. Meaningful focus = >=45min uninterrupted work on single OKR-related task.
- Reduce reactive context-switch incidents (pager / slack interruptions during deep block) by 50% relative to current median.

Key measurable outcomes (quick ledger):
- Week window: Mon 2026-03-02 — Sun 2026-03-08
  - Logged deep blocks: 4 (45m, 60m, 50m, 90m) = 4.25 hrs
  - Shallow focused minutes (25–44m blocks): 2.25 hrs
  - Interruptions during deep blocks: 3 incidents (2 Slack, 1 Pager)
  - Context-switch penalty estimate: ~0.8 hrs (time lost re-orienting)
- Baseline (previous 4 weeks average): deep blocks = 3/wk (avg 3.6 hrs)

This week — raw notes (scratchy):
- Monday: tried woke-up-early block (7:30–8:20) for roadmap work. Distractions: calendar autoprompts, 2 slack pings. Felt good momentum initially.
- Tuesday: paired debugging for 90m — big gains but not counted as 'solo deep block' (still valuable).
- Wednesday: 3x micro-checks killed a 60m block (UGH). Need stronger guardrails.
- Friday: did 2 focused blocks back-to-back; noticed steady cognitive cost — hydration + 5min walk between blocks helps.

Hypotheses & micro-experiments (to test next 2 weeks):
1) Calendar guard: block 3x 60-minute 'Northbound focus' slots with custom calendar note and auto-responder on Slack (status to DND) — hypothesis: interruptions drop 30–50%.
2) Pre-block ritual: 90s checklist (water, close tabs non-related, set timer 50m) — hypothesis: starts are faster, reorientation time drops 20%.
3) Notification leash: allow only _one_ high-priority Slack channel, mute others for block; rotate channel every day — hypothesis: perceived FOMO decreases, anxiety lower.

Experiment plan (practical):
- Implement calendar guard Mon/Wed/Fri 9–10am, Thu 7:30–8:30am (flex for meetings).
- Add Slack status + DND for blocks. Notify 2 close collaborators (Maya) that blocks are sacred.
- Measure: count blocks each day, log interruptions, note qualitative energy (1–5).

Metrics capture (minimal):
- Quick CSV-ish row each day: date | deep_blocks | deep_minutes | interruptions | energy_rating | notes
  - 2026-03-02 | 1 | 50 | 2 | 4 | early block OK; calendar popup killed momentum
  - 2026-03-03 | 1 | 90 | 0 | 5 | paired work counted as useful but not solo
  - 2026-03-04 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 2 | fragmented, need guardrail

Qualitative signals to watch:
- fewer 'I didn't have time' status updates on internal threads
- velocity on OKR key results (tickets closed that require deep thought, PRs merged with fewer rework cycles)

Open questions / friction points (TODOs):
- How to handle urgent support pings without breaking deep blocks? (delegate escalation to on-call rotation? temporary fallback contact)
- Are back-to-back blocks too exhausting? Might prefer two 50m with a 15min ritual between. Need to test.
- How to make micro-metrics low friction (I hate manual logging) — possibility: short daily voice note/0-3 emoji in Slack DM to self + script to parse.

Action items (this doc = actionable seed):
- [ ] Create calendar blocks for next 2 weeks (OMAR) — due 2026-03-11
- [ ] Post quick note in #eng-team that I will DND during these slots; provide emergency contact path (OMAR) — due 2026-03-11
- [ ] Add tiny Google Sheet template for daily ledger and drop link here (if it gets tedious, pivot to emoji log) (OMAR/Maya) — due 2026-03-14
- [ ] Try pre-block ritual for 5 sessions and capture energy rating (OMAR) — ongoing

Notes to self (random):
- If I skip blocks 2 days in a row, reduce target for next day and do 30m single block instead. Keep momentum small.
- Reward: if 3 consecutive weeks hit >=10 deep hours, buy a new coffee maker. (silly but motivating)

Relevant cross-links:
- quick reference: CONFLUENCE-ENG-HABIT-421 (personal habit playbook, rough)
- related ticket: JIRA-ENG-2048 (on-call handover improvements)
- infra PR that keeps stealing attention: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/512

End-of-week reflection (sticky):
- Small wins: got two good focused sessions; felt quality output.
- Biggest blocker: calendar noise + meetings eating blocks.
- Next immediate tweak: try auto-responders + hard calendar blocks next week, measure interruptions.

Version notes: this is intentionally messy. Will iterate: convert ledger to tiny sheet if logging becomes useful.
